product.name: Ubbink OFT/1F Flat Roof Vent/Terminal
product.description: Suitable for soil and vent systems, Ubbink's OFT/1F Flat Roof Vent/Terminal is the perfect option for flat roof extraction. It is also usable for natural (passive) or mechanical ventilation installations. Ideal for a felt roof covering, providing a large free vent area with a low Pascal resistance figure. This vent/terminal is available with varying pipe diameters to allow termination through a flat roof to ducting. There are also varying flange types, five included, for different roof coverings such as Asphalt, Felt, EPDM, Bitumen and PVC. Additionally, the Ubbink OFT/1 has a stack cap to fix mechanically to ensure the system is more secure when installed in extreme weather. If needed, this part is removable for servicing purposes. product.name: Ubiflex Black 3.5mm B3 Lead Alternative
product.description: This Ubiflex Black 3.5mm thick B3 Lead Alternative is a non-lead flashing material suitable for all applications where traditional lead is applied. It is manufactured with a modified polyethin compound and features an aluminium mesh reinforcement. As a result of its manufacturing, Ubiflex is environmentally friendly, non-toxic and recyclable, assisting in it being only of value to the installed as it has no re-sale value as scrap. Ubiflex is 80% lighter than lead to assist with handling, structural, health and safety advantages. It is also 50% quicker to install than lead, is entirely malleable, can be worked in both directions and is self-sealing if punctured. As a lead alternative, Ubiflex is also not susceptible to thermal movement, which allows aprons up to 12m long to be formed without seams or expansion joints, meaning there is less wastage than with traditional materials. product.name: Wrekin SX GRID 4m x 50m Biaxial Geogrid
product.description:
WREKIN SX GRID Biaxial geogrids can solve pavement problems by providing omni-axial reinforcement to granular sub-bases, capping layers & railway ballasts in areas of weak or variable soils. When granular particles are compacted over these grids, they partially penetrate and project through the apertures to create a strong and positive interlock. The load dispersal effect from the interlocking mechanism increases shearing resistance within the soil, improving compaction and allowing the sub base thickness to be decreased, ultimately reducing construction time and costs.
Applications for WREKIN SX GRID

Construction haul roads
Paved and unpaved roads
Railways and ports
Working platforms on weak sub-soils
Parking and paved areas
Multi-layer applications

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Internal Angle
product.description: Part of Alumasc's Aqualine range, this half round internal angle is designed to be installed as a corner of a guttering system. Installation is simple, with a simple clip fix required to support the brackets once they've been attached to the building fabric with concealed bracketry and versatile dry-sealed joints using internal unions positioned by sliding lock bars. Concealed site fixing and jointing enable the internal angle to fit in with the intricate detailing and smooth lines. Ensuring a clean appearance and secure installation that compliments and enhances the architectural design of your modern building. The design is also lightweight, compact and efficient, enhancing performance and high flow capacity; fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. This prevents potential damage of cracking and splitting. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Internal AngleVariety of colours, angles and gutter diameters to choose fromBBA-approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatingsManufactured using environmentally-friendly and 100% recyclable aluminiumAluminium material is durable and non-corrodible, ensuring long-lasting use and requiring minimal maintenanceLightweight for easy handling and transportationSmooth lines, secret fix bracketry and intricate detailing ensure a clean appearance to enhance buildingsSuitable for flush and projective eaves applicationsHigh-flow capacity to enhance performanceUnique, all-weather 'dry' jointing systems gives a completely clean and secure installationManufactured in the UK using aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloys to British standards BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101When it comes to application, this guttering corner can be fitted to flush and projecting eaves applications. It is also available in various colours, angles and diameters to ensure you have the right one for your system. BBA certification also applies to the guttering as its coating is a factory-applied polyester powder. So you can rely on the quality and colour of guttering to last for years to come. At least 40 years in fact in rural and suburban areas, as well as up to 25 years in industrial and marine areas. Little maintenance is required once it has been installed. Installation is simple, with a simple clip fix required to support the brackets once they've been attached to the building fabric with concealed bracketry and versatile dry-sealed joints using internal unions positioned by sliding lock bars. Concealed site fixing and jointing enable the internal angle to fit in with the intricate detailing and smooth lines. Ensuring a clean appearance and secure installation that compliments and enhances the architectural design of your modern building. The design is also lightweight, compact and efficient, enhancing performance and high flow capacity; fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. This prevents potential damage of cracking and splitting. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Starter Pack
product.description: This Aqualine starter pack contains the tools required to install your Half Round extruded aluminium gutter system. This includes P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This starter pack provides you with the necessary tools for a successful and easy installation.  This starter pack is quick and easy to use with the Aqualine gutter system using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing that gives a completely clean external appearance. The Half Round gutters drop and lock onto concealed brackets where internal joints are dry-sealed, aligned and locked using sliding single front lock bars. This starter pack ensures a fully secure gutter system allowing free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Starter PackQuick and easy to use and install your Half Round gutter system  Helps to enhance buildings with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry giving a completely clean appearance  Lightweight materials to work with making them easy to handle  Minimal maintenance needed once guttering is installed  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Environmentally friendly guttering, made from robust, non-corrosive, recyclable aluminiumThis Aqualine starter pack will help to ensure smooth lines and intricate detailing to contemporary designed buildings with the Half Round guttering with a high flow capacity for enhanced performance. The Half Round gutter systems are suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications which can be perfected with the help of your starter pack.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Stop-End
product.description: Designed to prevent rainwater from continuously flowing around your building’s gutters, this Half Round stop-end assists the direction of water towards a gutter or running outlet into the rainwater system below. Manufactured as part of the extruded aluminium Half Round guttering system, this stop-end is part of an efficient and compact rainwater system.Enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural appeal of modern designed buildings, this Aqualine stop-end is part of the Half Round gutter system that displays intricate detailing and smooth lines and is perfect for both flush and eaves applications. This stop-end fully accommodates free linear thermal movement, reducing the risk of damage through cracking or splitting, and enhances the high flow capacity and performance of the Half Round guttering. This robust and non-corrodible aluminium stop-end is long-lasting with minimal maintenance required after installation and a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas).Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Stop-EndAvailable in a variety of colours with BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system for a clean exterior appearance  Made from 100% recyclable and environmentally friendly aluminium  Made from non-corrodible and robust aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/ suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas)  Lightweight and easy to install and handle  Minimal maintenance requirements  Enhances buildings with smooth lines, intricate details and secret fix bracketry  Available in a range sizes with left and right-handed stop-ends  Has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance   Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  Manufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101Light and easy to install, this stop-end uses concealed site fixing and jointing with dry sealed joints using internal unions secured by sliding lock bars and a simple clip fix once support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric for a completely clean external appearance and straightforward and secure installation. Available in a variety of factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder colour coatings and in a range of diameters with your choice of left or right-handed stop-end.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Union Clip
product.description: This Deep Run union clip can be used to join two sections of gutter together while fixed to the fascia board to support the joint. This union clip provides support for the Aqualine Deep Run extruded aluminium gutter system. Easy to install and light in weight, this union clip is available in a variety of colours with a BBA approved factory-applied polyester powder coating to complement your Deep Run gutter system.This straightforward union clip is ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications with a unique all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system to give a clean external appearance. With a simple installation process, the Deep Run gutters have a concealed site fixing and jointing and are easy to install once the support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric with all remaining assembly fixed by a simple clip with dry sealed joints using internal unions secured by sliding lock bars to ensure a completely secure installation. This clean external appearance contributes to the smooth lines and intricate detailing, improving and complementing the architectural character and appearance of modern designed buildings. This Deep Run union clip is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint. The Aqualine Deep Run guttering, supported by this union clip is perfect for areas that experience higher than average rainfall or in areas where large amounts of water need to be dealt with and is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances performance and high flow capacity and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run External Angle
product.description: This deep run external angle from Alumasc’s Aqualine guttering range has all the benefits of an Aqualine half round external angle – designed to explore outwardly (external) corners of a roofline and avoid any potential obstructions – but does it with a deeper profile that can contain more water and therefore withstand a greater amount of rain. The Aqualine deep run external angle can be provided as a 90º or 135º as per your needs, and maintains a high-performing product within the strong and effective Aqualine collection. Aqualine aluminum guttering looks great on contemporary builds with the potential for hidden fixings and the fact that it can be installed either flush against the eave or slightly away from it. Made with movement from thermal change in mind, this range is innovative and modern, as well as environmentally friendly with 100% recyclable materials. product.description: This deep run external angle from Alumasc’s Aqualine guttering range has all the benefits of an Aqualine half round external angle – designed to explore outwardly (external) corners of a roofline and avoid any potential obstructions – but does it with a deeper profile that can contain more water and therefore withstand a greater amount of rain. The Aqualine deep run external angle can be provided as a 90º or 135º as per your needs, and maintains a high-performing product within the strong and effective Aqualine collection. Aqualine aluminum guttering looks great on contemporary builds with the potential for hidden fixings and the fact that it can be installed either flush against the eave or slightly away from it. Made with movement from thermal change in mind, this range is innovative and modern, as well as environmentally friendly with 100% recyclable materials. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running Outlet
product.description: The deep run running outlet connects the gutter and downpipe outlet in Aqualine deep run systems so that rainwater can easily continue on and flow through the drainage system without problem. Specifically for use in Alumasc’s Aqualine deep run guttering, this aluminium product comfortably allows for high volumes of water. Extruded aluminium is what makes this deep run running outlet so tough and versatile with rigorous defiance against breakage and splintering under changing weather circumstances. The deep run profile sufficiently holds and channels vast quantities of rainwater towards the drainage system, and Alumasc’s advanced technology makes for guttering that looks neat, current, and modern and that can also withstand the common changes of thermal movement at the same time. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running OutletVarious downpipe sizing  Deters wear and tear from impact and extended use  Corrosion resilient  Easily installed and just as easily recycled  Aqualine range is patented  Member of the deep run range  UK made with adherence to excellent British standards (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6)  Multiple aesthetics can be achieved with the BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder colour choices. Compatible with several eave installations and virtually undetectable attachments, this deep run running outlet is one of many Alumasc Aqualine products that is constantly beneficial and commits to peak performance every time.

Specifically for use in Alumasc’s Aqualine deep run guttering, this aluminium product comfortably allows for high volumes of water. Extruded aluminium is what makes this deep run running outlet so tough and versatile with rigorous defiance against breakage and splintering under changing weather circumstances. The deep run profile sufficiently holds and channels vast quantities of rainwater towards the drainage system, and Alumasc’s advanced technology makes for guttering that looks neat, current, and modern and that can also withstand the common changes of thermal movement at the same time. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running OutletVarious downpipe sizing  Deters wear and tear from impact and extended use  Corrosion resilient  Easily installed and just as easily recycled  Aqualine range is patented  Member of the deep run range  UK made with adherence to excellent British standards (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6)  Multiple aesthetics can be achieved with the BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder colour choices. Compatible with several eave installations and virtually undetectable attachments, this deep run running outlet is one of many Alumasc Aqualine products that is constantly beneficial and commits to peak performance every time.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Stop-End
product.description: Designed for use with the Deep Run Aqualine range of extruded aluminium guttering, this Deep Run stop-end is ideal for areas that experience higher than average rainfall or in situations where large quantities of water need to be dealt with.Created to stop water from flowing around the gutter continuously, this stop-end can direct the water into a running or gutter outlet through to the rainwater system below. Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications, it is part of a compact yet efficient rainwater system that fully accommodates free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Stop-EndSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applicationsVariety of colours to choose from with left or right handed optionsNeat appearance with secret fix bracketryMinimal maintenance requirementsLightweight and easy to handle and installDurable and non-corrodibleEnvironmentally friendly and recyclableMade in the UK to British StandardsLife expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areasContributing to enhanced performance and high flow capacity, this stop-end comes in a variety of monochrome colours to choose from. Displaying smooth lines and intricate detailing, it is perfect for complementing and transforming the appearance and architectural character of your contemporary designed building. Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium, it is available left or right handed to complete your building’s guttering requirements.Straightforward to install providing a neat appearance, this stop-end is light and easy to handle. With secret fix bracketry and all-weather ‘dry’ jointing, the Deep Run gutters can drop and lock onto concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly

The moulded profile is one of three, and poses a modern take on the ogee gutter system. It suits an assortment of contemporary builds with unique styles and sleek, undetectable fixings while being versatile in eave applications (either flat against the eave or projected from it). Even better, the moulded range still accommodates high-level flow capacities and has the potential to last up to 40 years. 3m gutter assemblies are an excellent and cost-efficient means of applying your gutter run that exceeds expectations and conforms to high British standards.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyIncludes multiple polyester powder coloured coatings that are BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Moulded profile for cooperation with the moulded range  British standard aluminium extrusions (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6)  Produced in the UK  Includes fixings for sturdiness and support  Doesn’t require extensive maintenance  Can be recycled.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Union Clip
product.description: These moulded union clips are part of Alumasc's versatile and long-lasting 'Aqualine' range of fixtures and fittings, providing the building blocks for a wide variety of challenging domestic guttering projects. These clips come in a classic moulded Victorian profile that helps evoke the stately style of traditional cast-iron gutters but have been constructed with high-quality modern materials to get the best of both worlds. Made from quality extruded aluminium, these union clips snap securely around the gutters, making a sturdy connection between lengths and angles.The Aqualine range comes in a wide variety of diameters to suit the scale your next guttering build or retrofit and a variety of colours to suit the style, too, from sleek modern builds to stately traditional properties. In addition, this system has impressive longevity that matches its versatility, with all fixtures lasting up to 40 years in rural and suburban areas. Easy to handle, easy to install, and with a secure locking bar system for watertight seals, it's easy to see how this system can boost the potential of your next major guttering project or refit.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Union ClipRugged and reliable connection between Aqualine moulded guttering sectionsTough and durable extruded aluminium combined with protective coatings provides up to forty years of serviceClassic moulded Victorian style
product.variant_name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Union Clip in Mouse Grey - 140mm x 100mm

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External Angle
product.description:
This external moulded angle is part of Alumasc's 'Aqualine' range of guttering products, combining traditional design elements and aesthetics with highly durable modern materials to produce an excellent all-rounder for your next domestic guttering project. Emulating the moulded guttering profiles of period cast iron, these external angles are a perfect addition to traditional properties looking to keep their Victorian charm.However, period design no longer means putting up with the cost and added installation woes of cast iron. This range of guttering products is constructed using recycled aluminium and a long-lasting polyester powder coating approved by the British Board of Agrément (BBA). Under the right conditions, this durable combination of materials can last up to 40 years in suburban and rural areas, making for a durable and reliable system. In addition, the Aqualine range is lightweight and easy to handle, taking into account heat warping thanks to a clever notched design and keeping a watertight seal with sliding lock bars and dry joint seals.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter Pack
product.description: This Alumasc Aqualine starter pack contains P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This includes all the necessary tools to help you to commence an easy and successful installation process of the Moulded extruded aluminium gutter system.This starter pack ensures a quick and easy installation using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing. This starter pack secures intricate details and smooth lines with a modern appearance for contemporary designed buildings with a completely clean outer appearance.  This lightweight and easy to handle, starter pack ensures the Moulded gutters can be locked and dropped into place onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear. This safeguards the entire gutter system is completely secure while allowing free linear thermal movement at every joint.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter PackQuick and easy to install your Moulded gutter system  Once support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric all remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix  Helps to enhance your building with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a completely clean appearance  Environmentally friendly and made from durable, long-life, recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to handle materials  Minimal maintenance required  Available in two different gutter diameter sizes  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)This Moulded guttering system has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, while this starter pack is suited to help install both flush and projecting eaves applications.  Once installed, this gutter system requires minimal maintenance, made from long-lasting, durable and non-corrodible aluminium. Available in two different sizes, this starter pack is quick and easy to help you with your installation needs.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-End
product.description: This lightweight and durable stop-end is available in two different sizes, a wide selection of colours and left or right-handed, depending on the side of your installation needs. Made from recyclable aluminium, this stop-end is part of the Aqualine range of extruded aluminium gutter systems, providing a compact and efficient rainwater system.This moulded stop-end is designed to create an end to a run of guttering, preventing rainwater from running around the entire building and helping to direct water into a running outlet or gutter outlet. Ideal for enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural character of your building, this moulded stop-end is part of the Aqualine system which provides smooth lines and intricate detailing to contemporary designed buildings. With a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, this stop-end is suited to both flush and projecting eaves applications and is designed to fully accommodate free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-EndBBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Manufactured in the UK  Based on aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573:, BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas  Lightweight and easy to install with concealed brackets for a clean appearance  Durable and non-corrodible with minimal maintenance once installed  Enhances the appearance of buildings with smooth lines and intricate details with a range of colours to choose from  High flow capacity for enhanced performance  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  Environmentally friendly and made from recyclable aluminiumThis easy to handle and install moulded stop-end uses a unique dry jointing system with secret fix bracketry to conceal the site fixing and give a completely clean external appearance. This stop-end can drop and lock onto the concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned and lock using slide bars, located at the front and rear.  This moulded stop-end requires minimal maintenance once installed and is completely secure.

product.description: This lightweight and durable stop-end is available in two different sizes, a wide selection of colours and left or right-handed, depending on the side of your installation needs. Made from recyclable aluminium, this stop-end is part of the Aqualine range of extruded aluminium gutter systems, providing a compact and efficient rainwater system.This moulded stop-end is designed to create an end to a run of guttering, preventing rainwater from running around the entire building and helping to direct water into a running outlet or gutter outlet. Ideal for enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural character of your building, this moulded stop-end is part of the Aqualine system which provides smooth lines and intricate detailing to contemporary designed buildings. With a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, this stop-end is suited to both flush and projecting eaves applications and is designed to fully accommodate free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-EndBBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Manufactured in the UK  Based on aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573:, BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas  Lightweight and easy to install with concealed brackets for a clean appearance  Durable and non-corrodible with minimal maintenance once installed  Enhances the appearance of buildings with smooth lines and intricate details with a range of colours to choose from  High flow capacity for enhanced performance  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  Environmentally friendly and made from recyclable aluminiumThis easy to handle and install moulded stop-end uses a unique dry jointing system with secret fix bracketry to conceal the site fixing and give a completely clean external appearance. This stop-end can drop and lock onto the concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned and lock using slide bars, located at the front and rear.  This moulded stop-end requires minimal maintenance once installed and is completely secure.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Internal Angle
product.description: This internal angle guttering has been designed to fit around corners of buildings and in conjunction with the Alumasc Aqualine Box extruded aluminium guttering system to help direct the flow of rainwater into a gutter or running outlet into a water system below. Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications, this internal angle contributes to an efficient and compact rainwater system. Manufactured from durable and non-corrosive aluminium and available in a range of colours, diameters and angles, this internal angle can be made to fit your gutting needs.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Internal AngleManufactured in the United Kingdom to British standards  Made with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Made from recyclable aluminium and environmentally friendly  Made from robust and non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years for rural /suburban areas and up to 25 years for industrial/marine areas  Ideal for enhancing buildings with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a clean appearance  Light in weight and easy to install and handle  Minimal maintenance once installed  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  High flow capacity for enhanced performance  Available in a range of colours, diameters and anglesQuick and easy to install, this lightweight internal angle uses a unique dry jointing system to give a completely clean external appearance. This Aqualine Internal angle gutter can drop and lock onto concealed brackets with locked and aligned internal joints using slide/lock bars situated at the front and rear. Ensuring a completely secure gutter system, this internal angle allows for free linear thermal movement.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Starter Pack
product.description:
This box starter pack is mainly manufactured from aluminium, and is part of the Aqualine range of aluminium guttering from Alumasc. With years of experience in the guttering and rainwater system industry, Alumasc create a range of products that, by using new technologies and manufacturing techniques, not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of quality, performance and style.
This starter pack has been designed specifically for use with box profile guttering from the Aqualine range. The box profile is a contemporary design with sharp angular lines to create a strong visual statement, as well as maximum capacity and efficient flow rates.
The starter pack has been designed to provide you with everything you need to install box profile Aqualine guttering securely, to create a durable and weathertight run of guttering on your property. The box profile starter pack consists of 10 spare lock bars, 20 shims, 2 jointing tools, 20 no.12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and P80 joint and seal lubricant, to create a pristine, built to last finish.
Why choose Alumasc Aqualine guttering?
The Alumasc Aqualine range of guttering is part of the contemporary aluminium rainwater range from Alumasc.
Performance and design
The Alumasc Aqualine guttering system features a number of characteristics that make it one of the highest performing gutter systems available. The design of Aqualine takes into account potential dangers of cracking and splitting due to thermal movement, so at every joint across the gutter system thermal movement can occur without causing damage.
The Aqualine gutter system has also been designed to be installed with concealed fixing and jointing, which not only helps to create a clean external appearance, but also helps minimise the potential for leaks to occur. This is further aided by the dry joint seals, which are secured by sliding lock bars for maximum watertightness.
Installation
The installation process of Alumasc Aqualine is quick and easy, aided by the fact that the gutters are lightweight and easy to handle. Support brackets simply need to be fixed to the building fabric, and then a simple clip fix is all that is required to secure the gutter in place.
Aesthetics
The Aqualine range is available in a vast range of colours, sizes and profiles, which allow a high level of customisation in order to create the perfect look for your project. Whether you’re looking to create a subtle guttering run with relatively traditional profiles, or you want to make the gutters a feature, in bright colours and contemporary profiles, the Alumasc Aqualine range will have exactly what you are looking for, with BBA approved polyester powder coatings, and including all the accessories you’ll need to create a single, uniform look.
Environmentally friendly
The Aqualine guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the Aqualine guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

With years of experience in the guttering and rainwater system industry, Alumasc create a range of products that, by using new technologies and manufacturing techniques, not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of quality, performance and style.
This starter pack has been designed specifically for use with box profile guttering from the Aqualine range. The box profile is a contemporary design with sharp angular lines to create a strong visual statement, as well as maximum capacity and efficient flow rates.
The starter pack has been designed to provide you with everything you need to install box profile Aqualine guttering securely, to create a durable and weathertight run of guttering on your property. The box profile starter pack consists of 10 spare lock bars, 20 shims, 2 jointing tools, 20 no.12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and P80 joint and seal lubricant, to create a pristine, built to last finish.
Why choose Alumasc Aqualine guttering?
The Alumasc Aqualine range of guttering is part of the contemporary aluminium rainwater range from Alumasc.
Performance and design
The Alumasc Aqualine guttering system features a number of characteristics that make it one of the highest performing gutter systems available. The design of Aqualine takes into account potential dangers of cracking and splitting due to thermal movement, so at every joint across the gutter system thermal movement can occur without causing damage.
The Aqualine gutter system has also been designed to be installed with concealed fixing and jointing, which not only helps to create a clean external appearance, but also helps minimise the potential for leaks to occur. This is further aided by the dry joint seals, which are secured by sliding lock bars for maximum watertightness.
Installation
The installation process of Alumasc Aqualine is quick and easy, aided by the fact that the gutters are lightweight and easy to handle. Support brackets simply need to be fixed to the building fabric, and then a simple clip fix is all that is required to secure the gutter in place.
Aesthetics
The Aqualine range is available in a vast range of colours, sizes and profiles, which allow a high level of customisation in order to create the perfect look for your project. Whether you’re looking to create a subtle guttering run with relatively traditional profiles, or you want to make the gutters a feature, in bright colours and contemporary profiles, the Alumasc Aqualine range will have exactly what you are looking for, with BBA approved polyester powder coatings, and including all the accessories you’ll need to create a single, uniform look.
Environmentally friendly
The Aqualine guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the Aqualine guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of your roof, this gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run that channels the water away into a downpipe and into the rainwater system below. This high-capacity gutter is suitable for traditional or modern buildings and has been manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Made with moulded sides and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is part of a gutter system that has been fully engineered for a traditional, well-proven installation method of simple wet sealed and bolted joints, fixed directly to your building fabric. With a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry, generally concealed after fixing, this gutter assembly is lightweight and easy to install with minimal maintenance required after installation. This gutter assembly can be exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system, is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system and can provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyMade in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in a selection of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance required for a long-lasting installation  Made from 100% recyclable, environmentally friendly aluminium  Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a selection of diameters  Easy to install with a simple, well-proven method and light in weight to handle  Wet jointed and fixed directly to building fabricThis robust and non-corrodible aluminium gutter assembly can reduce the risk of heat damage, avoiding splitting and cracking by fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. Available in a selection of diameters and colours, this gutter assembly is coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder to suit your gutter requirements. Made from long-lasting aluminium, this gutter assembly has a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Running Outlet
product.description: This box running outlet has been exclusively constructed to direct water into the drain by making a connection between a gutter run and a downpipe, specifically in the Alumasc Aqualine range of aluminium guttering products. Innovative technology has gone into the Aqualine gutter collection by Alumasc to create products that hold up to high standards. Featuring strong aluminium constructions that combat corrosion and rusting, the Aqualine range pre-empts damage that can occur during thermal movement and is therefore designed to allow the space for this process. Not only light and ideal for long-term use, but this guttering also looks tidy with hidden bracketry, as well as withstands leaks with sliding locks for joints. With an assortment of sizes, colours, and models, this box running outlet can be picked to perfectly match your Aqualine box guttering. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Running OutletEasy to install and manoeuvre  Recyclable aluminium that lasts a long time  Involves capacity for high flow  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Made in the UK.

product.description: This box running outlet has been exclusively constructed to direct water into the drain by making a connection between a gutter run and a downpipe, specifically in the Alumasc Aqualine range of aluminium guttering products. Featuring strong aluminium constructions that combat corrosion and rusting, the Aqualine range pre-empts damage that can occur during thermal movement and is therefore designed to allow the space for this process. Not only light and ideal for long-term use, but this guttering also looks tidy with hidden bracketry, as well as withstands leaks with sliding locks for joints. With an assortment of sizes, colours, and models, this box running outlet can be picked to perfectly match your Aqualine box guttering. product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded Stop-End
product.description: This aluminium moulded stop end is a light, well-manufactured, and useful addition to your GX moulded guttering systems. Alumasc provides you with a reliable fitting to assist you in draining water and carrying it through the guttering. This stop end – purchasable in both left and right hand depending on use – attaches to the moulded running outlet and aims to prevent rainwater from floating around in the gutter run to keep your GX moulded system flowing effectively. Produced to high standards, Alumasc’s moulded range from the GX guttering collection is long-lasting and includes larger sizes to compensate for heavier rainfall. This stop end works fantastically to function with the rest of the GX moulded products and forms a watertight seal to avoid irritating leakages. Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded Stop-EndDifferent finishes for colour coding  Reusable and recyclable aluminium  Applicable to BBA (British Board of Agrément) guttering guidelines  UK crafted  Good for traditional and modern applications.Maintenance is made easy with the aluminium construction seeing as it requires minimal fuss and repair work, and the moulded GX products fit to your building without need for extra bracketry.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal Angle
product.description: Designed with an internal returned lip and moulded sides, this internal angle is suited for use on the corners of your installation for modern or traditional buildings with your choice of being exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system. This internal angle has been designed as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Durable and fully engineered, this box section internal angle gutter has been designed for a traditional, well-proven method of simply wet sealing and bolting joints fixed directly onto the building fabric and is suitable for traditional or modern buildings. Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required, this internal angle is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, reducing the risk of cracking or splitting through heat damage. Providing an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution, this internal angle is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit solution and requires a simple screw fixing with bracketry which is generally concealed after installation.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal AngleManufactured in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in two different colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium for minimal maintenance and a long-lasting installation  Made from environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a range of angles and diameters  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and simple method   Wet jointed and fixed directly to the building fabricAvailable in a range of diameters and angles, this lightweight internal angle is made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance required after installation. Available in your choice of two colours, this internal angle is coated with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder.

product.description: Created for functional use alongside the innovative variety of GX aluminium gutter products, this smooth standard running outlet is specially crafted to let rainwater flow into the system by connecting gutter runs to downpipes. The Alumasc GX collection is a versatile and high-quality range, designed for simple installation that looks stylish and put together on application, whether it be contemporary builds or traditional. Strength and longevity are only two fantastic benefits of GX systems, with an endless list of advantages to follow – including rust deterring aluminium and leeway for heat-related expansion and contraction. GX smooth is particularly professional in finish, specifically intended to keep screws concealed, with a modern wall construction with a soft lip that lives up to that smooth name. This outlet performs fantastically with the rest of the smooth GX structure. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This two part circular offset angles at 135º in order to build a connection between the running outlet and the downpipe of your Flushjoint system, in turn letting the downpipe fix flush against the wall. Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part OffsetElaborate colour palette, all coated in BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder  UK made extruded aluminium (6063 T6 alloy) that meets British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  Various sizes available  Recyclable to reduce waste.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Access Pipe
product.description: This access pipe is from Alumasc’s Flushjoint downpipe collection, particularly from the array of square fittings and guttering they offer. It works in the same manner as a regular downpipe, except it has an opening where you can clear any blockages with relative ease. The Flushjoint range performs just as efficiently as Alumasc’s fellow ranges, to the point that it can be used in tandem with GX, Aqualine and Heritage products that can accommodate to Flushjoint sizes and connections. With an assortment of colour options that all contain BBA approved (British Board of Agrément) polyester powder, this square profile access pipe makes a fantastic contribution to modern or refurbished builds that suit slick and discreet joints. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Access PipeSize variation  Up to 40 year life expectation  Recyclable extruded aluminium (grade 6063 T6) that is unlikely to rust, crack, and corrode  Suited to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 755)  Versatile and easy to install  UK made.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe Bend
product.description: Available in 92.5º, 112.5º, and 135º angles, this square profile pipe bend is a part of the innovative Flushjoint downpipe range from Alumasc. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe BendAdvantageous in colour selection  BBA (British Board of Agrément) authorised polyester powder finishes  Sturdy and strong to defend against impact, corrosion, and rusting  Requires minimal upkeep and lasts exceptionally well to make for a cost-effective option  Can be recycled and repurposed  Easy and almost undetectable mounting  Compatible with GX, Aqualine, and Heritage ranges  UK manufactured aluminium extrusions that cater to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755).

product.description: Available in 92.5º, 112.5º, and 135º angles, this square profile pipe bend is a part of the innovative Flushjoint downpipe range from Alumasc. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe BendAdvantageous in colour selection  BBA (British Board of Agrément) authorised polyester powder finishes  Sturdy and strong to defend against impact, corrosion, and rusting  Requires minimal upkeep and lasts exceptionally well to make for a cost-effective option  Can be recycled and repurposed  Easy and almost undetectable mounting  Compatible with GX, Aqualine, and Heritage ranges  UK manufactured aluminium extrusions that cater to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755).

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 92.5 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This square profile two part offset is an immensely useful product designed to connect your running outlet to your downpipe and restore it to the wall where it can be fixed accordingly.The offset accommodates a 92.5° angle and involves concealed spigots that create seamless attachments between parts. Aluminium guttering by Alumasc is excellent in quality, easy to set up, and 100% recyclable at the end of its long-term use. Being that it is a member of the Flushjoint range of Alumasc guttering, this offset can be just as useful in a GX, Heritage, or Aqualine guttering system on up-to-date builds with contemporary layouts, as long as the paired items are completely compatible with the offset. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 92.5 Degree Two Part OffsetVariety of sizes and polyester powder colours that are BBA (British Board of Agrément) approvedUK craftedExtruded aluminium (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755)Non-corrodible and painless maintenance (grade 6063 T6 alloy)Square Flushjoint profile

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed Offset
product.description: With just one part, this 135° fixed offset is one of the multiple products in the Flush joint range from Alumasc. The squared profile works perfectly with other squared profile downpipe systems, connecting them together with smooth hidden spigots.Flushjoint systems attach at the gutter running outlet and connect down towards the downpipe. This offset plays an important part in providing this connection – allowing a 135° angle to keep the downpipes firmly fixed on the wall with appropriate brackets, as well as forming a continuous path for rainfall to find the drainage system. As one of Alumasc’s ranges, Flushjoint is constructed from non-corrosive and long-lasting extruded aluminium suitable for contemporary buildings and modern aesthetics. Although in the Flushjoint range, this square offset can be placed in Heritage, GX, and Aqualine gutters so long as the products are compatible. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed OffsetManufactured in the UK to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)Optional colours with BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powderSquare profileLow maintenance aluminiumSimple to install with spigotsBeneficial to the environment due to recyclability

product.description: On buildings that have small industrial assets or fixtures that could potentially impede the constant path in your downpipe system, these square small base clips work efficiently to fix pipes to the chosen surface while simultaneously avoiding these obstacles. With a square profile, this rainwater head works perfectly with the Flushjoint square downpipe collection, but it can also be applied to Alumasc’s aluminium GX, Aqualine, and Heritage installations where the Flushjoint’s specific pipe girth can be accommodated. This Flushjoint rainwater head also shares similarities with its fellow guttering ranges – versatility, longevity, and recyclability are only three of many. product.description:
Developed in the UK using heavy-grade aluminium with up to 25 years life expectancy (or 40 for rural/suburban applications), Alumasc's rainwater diverter is designed to fit with the square and rectangular Flushjoint downpipe system.
Choose from a range of BBA-approved, factory-applied polyester powder coatings, or opt for a plain mill finish for painted customisation on site.
Designed to offer all the performance and quality for which Alumasc products are known, this diverter is just the ticket for installing a fully customised downpipe system that's built to last.

Concealed spigots for smooth appearance – fits in with appearance of Alumasc Aqualine as a contemporary range
Compatible with Heritage, Aqualine and GX gutters
Not designed for use in underground drainage
Circular, square or rectangular pipes

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal Angle
product.description:
For gutter installations that require sharp turns of a corner or that need to avoid any potential interruptions for a straight path, this joggle internal angle is a fantastic product to connect to a joggle gutter run and therefore ensure water can flow from the gutter to the downpipe. 
This internal angle features a joggle profile as part of Alumasc’s GX joggle range, which makes it ideal to fit in with the joggle system as it shares a distinct design that accommodates heavy rainfall and utilises innovative technology, therefore allowing for thermal movement. GX gutters are suitable for high capacity flow and work fantastically on both traditional and contemporary builds. Joggle installations can be extremely discreet with easy bracketry and top straps, and this internal angle follows in line by subtly connecting to the guttering run.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal AngleSize options to suit different gutters  Resistant to corrosion and rusting  Unlikely to break or leak  Recyclable  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Perfect for longevity installations with a 25-40 year lifespan  Made from British standard aluminium (BS EN 1462:1997, BS EN 612:1996, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 485).

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Joggle gutter system range, this 3-meter gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run, designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of the roof and channel it away into the downpipe and to the rainwater system below. Light and easy to handle and install, this straightforward gutter assembly can be fixed with a simple, well-proven method with bolted and wet-sealed joints with a simple screw fixing and bracketry that can be hidden after installation to create a streamlined finish.Available in your choice of a wide variety of colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings and a range of gutter diameters to match your gutter system needs. Fully engineered and designed for traditional on-site wet jointing, this gutter assembly is perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. Made with vertical sides, sharp-angled bends and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is supported by top straps to increase rigidity and strength for your GX Joggle gutter system. Suitable for modern or traditional buildings, this adaptable gutter assembly can provide an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution and is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle 3m Gutter AssemblyCompatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Made in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a variety of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance requirements  Made from environmentally friendly, 100% recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and straightforward installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthYou can choose to expose or conceal your gutters, whichever suits your building. Made with robust and non-corrodible aluminium, this gutter assembly can fully accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint, reducing the risk of heat damage through splitting or cracking while aluminium has a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance requirements.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Stop-End
product.description: This Joggle stop-end can be used at the end of a gutter run to stop rainwater from running continuously around your building and helps to direct the water into an outlet through to a rainwater system below. This GX Joggle stop-end is compatible with the GX Joggle range of pressed aluminium gutter systems.This full-engineered and durable stop-end has been designed for traditional wet jointing on-site and is perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. Made with sharp-angled bends, a returned lip and vertical sides, this box section stop-end is supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strength. Suitable for modern or traditional buildings, this versatile stop-end can provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution with your choice of concealed or exposed gutters. This stop-end is available in a range of colours, factory finished with BBA certified polyester powder coatings and comes in a range of sizes with left or right-handed ends to tailor to your installation needs.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Stop-EndCompletely compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Made in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a wide variety of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters and left or right-handed  Made from robust, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance needed  Made from 100% recyclable aluminium  Easy to handle and fix with a well-proven and simple installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthThis lightweight stop-end is easy to install with a well-proven, straightforward method of bolted and wet-sealed joints with a simple screw fixing with bracketry which can be concealed after installation. Made from robust and non-corrosive aluminium, this stop-end has a life expectancy of 40 years for rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years for industrial/ marine areas with minimal maintenance required once installed. This stop-end is designed to wholly accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Standard Running Outlet
product.description:
This standard running outlet has been manufactured from aluminium and is part of the GX aluminium gutter range from Alumasc. Alumasc have been manufacturing high quality guttering and rainwater systems for years, and use new technologies and innovative manufacturing processes to create products that not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of performance, durability and design.
This standard running outlet has been designed specifically for use with GX guttering products with the joggle profile. The joggle range of GX guttering comprises of vertical sides, sharp angled bends, and a returned lip, and has been designed for use in areas of high rainfall as it copes with large volumes of water with no issues.
The running outlet provides a connection between a gutter run and a downpipe, in order to transport the rainwater from the roof and into the drainage system. The running outlet is most commonly connected to a gutter run towards the side of a house, and is often paired with a stop end to ensure water gets directed into the downpipe.
Why choose Alumasc GX guttering?
Performance
The Alumasc GX gutter range has been designed specifically as a high capacity gutter that can be used on both traditional and modern buildings. The Alumasc GX range is available in three different profiles, but each profile has been designed in a way that delivers maximum capacity and flow rate.
The GX Alumasc range of guttering is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, and is lightweight, durable and highly corrosion resistant.
Installation
The GX aluminium guttering range has been designed for traditional wet jointing on site. This involves the simple and well proven method of screw fixing with bracketry, which is generally concealed after installation to create a sleek and uniform finish.
The GX Joggle range is supported by top straps, whilst the GX Smooth range has been designed to not require any visible screw fixing or support brackets to create a smooth finish, whilst the GX Moulded range is wet jointed, fixed directly to the building fabric.
Environmentally friendly
The GX guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the GX guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

Ideal for both projecting eaves and flush applications, this Moulded gutter can be used as a direct replacement for cast iron gutters.
Easy to install and fix, this gutter is wet sealed with bolted joints with a range of fixing options. These gutter joints are secured with bolts or screws through integral holes/ slots, with slots in the rear for direct fixing and appropriate fixing holes, requiring support brackets for a direct fix. This gutter can be simply fixed to the wall by your choice of pipe clips or eared sockets. Available in a range of sizes in length and gutter diameters, this gutter provides the essential system required to collect rainwater and channel it away into the downpipe and rainwater collection system below.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Bend
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe Shoe with Ears 63mm - Plain

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Alumasc Old Style Rafter Bracket 40 Degrees Half Round Top Fix
product.description:
As part of the cast aluminium Heritage gutter system, this old-style rafter bracket is available in a range of two different sizes to fit your gutter needs, giving support as a top fix to your Half Round gutters. This 40° top fix is ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications.
Durable and non-corrosive, this bracket is made from pressure diecast aluminium and has a long life expectancy of up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas) and 40 years (rural/suburban areas) with minimal upkeep requirements once installed. As a perfect alternative to resemble cast iron, this bracket is suited to both new build and refurbishment applications for traditionally designed buildings with a BBA accredited process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings. product.name: Alumasc Heritage Beaded Deep Run Gutter
product.description:
These Alumasc 'Heritage' beaded deep-run gutters are the starting point for a reliable and robust range of guttering sections and fittings. An ideal pairing for traditional buildings that need every ounce of character preserved, these gutter sections are perfect for replacing older, heavier cast-iron fixtures or lending style to all sorts of contemporary builds. 
The 'Heritage' range uses durable coated aluminium to produce longevity, quality, and versatility for the best results in both flush and projecting eave applications. With British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval, this gutter system can last up to forty years in rural and suburban areas. In addition, these sections are easy to install thanks to wet-sealed and bolted joints, coming in a range of imperial measurements and popular colours.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Beaded Deep Run GutterDurable coated aluminium means these gutters can last up to forty years in suburban and rural areasMeets with British Standards and British Board of Agrément specificationsDesigned specifically for replacing older cast-iron fixturesSuitable for both flush and projecting eave applications

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements
